text:
Ashley: Hey team — AcmeCorp is requesting a question-by-question SIG drop. They want artifacts for ~12 control items within 48h. Can we map owners and deliverables?
Ben: I can own encryption + key mgmt artifacts. Will pull KMS rotation policy, key hierarchy diagram, and CMK access logs.
Claire: @Ben please redact account IDs, but keep key IDs. We'll mark anything that reveals customer PII.
Ashley: Good call. @Claire can you confirm the redaction checklist we should apply?
Claire: Redaction checklist: remove full ARNs tied to customers, mask IPs to /24, remove internal usernames; keep timestamps and event types. Also attach the SOC2 cert (redacted report ok).
Ben: Plan: 1) export KMS policy + rotation doc; 2) snapshot vault access logs (last 90d); 3) export quantized encryption config from infra repo. ETA 24h.
Deepak: We need an explicit statement about in-transit encryption (TLS min v1.2) and cipher suites. Also confirm no persistent PHI in POC dataset.
Ashley: No PHI. It's synthetic product metadata only. I'll confirm with Acme.
Ben: Upload path for artifacts: secure-share.redwood.com/acme-sig/ (SFTP). Use the following example:
```
scp artifacts/*.pdf uploader@secure-share.redwood.com:/incoming/acme-sig/1998765432/
```
Claire: Also include a network diagram with DMZ boundaries and VPC peering notes. If anything references internal ticket IDs, strip them.
Ashley: I'll coordinate the customer to accept redacted SOC2 and truncated logs. Need a short blurb for legal: "Artifacts provided are read-only extracts and have been redacted per our privacy policy." Thoughts?
Deepak: Fine. Add note that original unredacted artifacts are available under NDA and for SOC2 auditor review only.
Ben: Uploading initial KMS docs now. Will tag filenames like: kms-rotation-2026-03-xx.pdf (redacted).
UploadBot: File received: kms-rotation-2026-03-15.pdf (sha256: e3b0c442...). Location: /incoming/acme-sig/1998765432/kms-rotation-2026-03-15.pdf
Ashley: Thanks @Ben. Who's doing the question-by-question mapping into the SIG spreadsheet? Last time we had to map each SIG question -> artifact filename.
Claire: I can handle the mapping for security controls. Send me the spreadsheet template and I'll populate QIDs, artifact links, and notes.
Ben: I'll drop artifact links once uploads complete.
Ashley: Timeline check: Ben ETA 24h, Claire mapping ETA additional 12h after links. That meets 48h. I'll update the customer.
Deepak: One blocker: Acme asked about KMS key multi-region replication. Our answer should state: replication is manual and supported via Cross-Region Key replication doc. Ben, can you include the replication runbook?
Ben: Yep — adding runbook (redacted run commands).
Ashley: Sweet. I'll send a single email to Acme with links once Claire finishes mapping.
Claire: Quick QA: for any control that references "third-party pen test", we should attach the summary only (no vuln details).
Ashley: Noted. Anything else?
Ben: I'll also attach a short note about how we handle CI secrets and ephemeral credentials during POCs.
Deepak: Perfect. After upload, I'll do a quick review for accidental secrets.
UploadBot: All files for thread 1998765432 scanned — no secrets detected by secret-scan-v2.
Ashley: Awesome. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I’ll ping if customer asks for full, unredacted evidence (we'll need an NDA).
Claire: If they request SOC2 bridge letter, route to compliance@redwood for sign-off.
Ben: Closing out on my side. Files to check later: kms-rotation-2026-03-15.pdf, kms-access-logs-90d.csv.redacted, replication-runbook.pdf.redacted.
Ashley: Thread closed once customer confirms receipt. I'll update here.
